source_zip: inside-cover-source-audit.zip (archived scan-analysis ZIP supplied within conversation; do not infer original uncompressed scan identity)
method: threshold pixels (R>level) && (R>G*ratio) && (R>B*1.12), 5x5 morphological closing, connected-component foreground area>50; B image acts as opposite-cover negative control
outcome: Eight out of eight tested threshold combinations detect four independent displays on A and zero within the same coordinates on B. This operationalizes four-screen observation but does not demonstrate producer intent, four authentication scheme meaning, or sticker consumer.
epistemic_scope: Region manually fixed after first seeing monitor distribution. Threshold grid controls measurement stability only, not surprise under random-image null. Input files are reduced-size derived previews not untouched source scans.
